name: Room To Linger
source:
Join your friends Jessie, Sigun, & Tyler for a movie night like no other. You arrive late to the party, and it soon becomes clear that things aren't as they seem.

[From [url=https://unicornergames.itch.io/room-to-linger]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
和朋友傑西、西貢、泰勒共度一個非同尋常的電影之夜。你來晚了，而你很快就會發現，事情並不像表面那樣。
